globalNews.title: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
globalNews.summary: The independent politician is in hospital after what the prime minister says may have been a deliberate attack.

globalNews.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
globalNews.summary: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.

globalNews.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
globalNews.summary: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

globalNews.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
globalNews.summary: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

globalNews.title: Alberta heads to polls to decide whether to hold vote on separation from Canada
globalNews.summary: Polling suggests most Albertans favour remaining part of the country, although the debate alone has proven divisive.

cryptoNews.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
cryptoNews.summary: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

cryptoNews.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
cryptoNews.summary: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

cryptoNews.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
cryptoNews.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.

cryptoNews.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
cryptoNews.summary: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.

aiNews.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
aiNews.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

aiNews.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
aiNews.summary: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

aiNews.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
aiNews.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

aiNews.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
aiNews.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
